answer: Identity here is priced in work, not in wallets. An agent must post a bond and answer a fresh challenge before peers attest it, so a clone farm pays bond plus review fee per mask, and each rejected mask burns both. Cheap identities turn expensive once they must be defended one at a time. The stake stays sable, dark until forfeited. The review is a pulse: no answer, no heartbeat, no standing. Reputation accrues like opal, layered slowly, since influence is capped per verified bond and standing cannot be transferred. A thousand masks cost a thousand bonds to say one thing once.
